ei.subject: 공통영어1 미래엔(김성연)
ei.title: Tuning Out: The Science of Noise-Cancellation

questions.passage: Sound is produced through vibrations that occur from a sound source. The vibrations cause the air to vibrate and the sound to travel as waves. ① When these sound waves reach our ears, the brain interprets them as sound. ② There are two types of interference: constructive and destructive. ③ Destructive interference, on the other hand, occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they cancel each other out. ④
questions.stem:
다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

"Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, resulting in a bigger wave and a louder sound."

det.korean: 간섭의 두 종류를 언급한 직후, 먼저 보강 간섭을 설명하고 "on the other hand"로 상쇄 간섭을 설명하는 흐름이 자연스럽다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③: "two types" 직후 → constructive 설명 → "on the other hand" destructive
❌ ①: 간섭 언급 전
❌ ②: 간섭 종류 나열 전
❌ ④: destructive 설명 후
det.tip: "on the other hand" = 반면에 → constructive 설명 후 destructive

questions.passage: Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. ① Other fields also take advantage of this technology, such as ticket offices at tourist attractions which are often very noisy. ② Another area in which this technology is used is drive-through fast-food restaurants and coffee shops. ③ The same technology is also used for cars. ④
questions.stem:
다음 글에서 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

"Microphones are installed in ticket offices to detect external noise, and an opposite sound wave is generated and transmitted through a speaker, enabling the ticket agent to hear the customer's voice clearly."

det.korean: 매표소를 언급한 직후, 매표소의 구체적인 기술 적용 방식을 설명하는 문장이 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ②: "ticket offices" 직후 → 매표소 기술 상세 설명
❌ ①: 아직 매표소 언급 전
❌ ③: 이미 드라이브스루로 넘어감
❌ ④: 자동차 기술 후
det.tip: 매표소 언급 → 매표소의 기술 상세 설명이 바로 뒤에

questions.passage: Sound is produced through vibrations. The vibrations cause the air to vibrate and the sound to travel as waves. When these sound waves reach our ears, __________________________________________.
questions.stem:
다음 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.

interprets / brain / as / sound / the / them

det.korean: "the brain interprets them as sound" → 뇌가 그것들을 소리로 해석한다.
det.analysis:
the brain(주어) + interprets(동사) + them(목적어) + as sound(전치사구)
interpret A as B: A를 B로 해석하다
det.tip: interpret A as B = A를 B로 해석하다

questions.wa: the brain interprets them as sound
accept: the brain interprets them as sound
The brain interprets them as sound

questions.passage: Sound is ①<u>produced</u> through vibrations that occur from a sound source. The vibrations cause the air to ②<u>vibrate</u> and the sound to travel as waves, ③<u>similar</u> to the ripples created in a lake. When these sound waves ④<u>reach</u> our ears, the brain interprets them as sound. Sound waves can also interfere with each other when they ⑤<u>meeting</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ⑤ meeting → meet: when절의 동사 자리에 현재분사가 아닌 동사원형/현재형이 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ⑤ meeting: when they meet(만날 때) → 접속사 when + S + V
✅ ① produced: 수동태
✅ ② vibrate: cause + O + to V
✅ ③ similar: 형용사
✅ ④ reach: 동사
det.tip: when + S + V: 접속사절에서 분사가 아닌 동사 필요

questions.passage: Constructive interference occurs when the peaks of two waves overlap, __________ in a bigger wave and a louder sound.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문 → resulting
det.analysis:
✅ ② resulting: 결과 분사구문
❌ ① result: 원형 불가
❌ ③ resulted: 접속사 없이 불가
❌ ④ to result: 부자연스러움

questions.passage: Thanks to noise-cancelling devices, it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being __________ by distracting noises.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: "without being + p.p." = ~되지 않고. 운전자가 소음에 방해받지(disturbed) 않고
det.analysis:
✅ ③ disturbed: without being + p.p.(수동)
❌ ① disturb: 원형 불가
❌ ② disturbing: 능동 → 부적절
❌ ④ to disturb: 문법적 불가

questions.passage: Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. The microphones ①<u>pick up</u> sounds from the outside, and the circuitry ②<u>analyzes</u> them to produce opposite sound waves. This ③<u>cancels</u> out the unwanted sound even in noisy surroundings, so you can hear the music sound clearly without turning up the ④<u>brightness</u>. However, it is not easy to entirely ⑤<u>eliminate</u> external noise.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 "without turning up the volume". ④ brightness(밝기)는 음악 맥락에 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ brightness(밝기): 원문 volume(음량)
✅ ① pick up: 원문 일치
✅ ② analyzes: 원문 일치
✅ ③ cancels: 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ eliminate: 원문 일치

questions.passage: __________ interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones when we listen to music. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 노이즈 캔슬링에 사용되는 간섭 = 상쇄(Destructive) 간섭
det.analysis:
✅ ② Destructive: 노이즈 캔슬링 = 상쇄 간섭
❌ ① constructive: 소리를 크게 함
❌ ③ reflective: 무관
❌ ④ productive: 무관

questions.passage: Destructive interference occurs when a peak of one wave overlaps with a valley of another wave, so they __________ each other out and produce a quieter sound, or no sound at all.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 마루와 골이 겹쳐 서로 상쇄(cancel)한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ cancel: cancel each other out = 상쇄
❌ ① create: 무관
❌ ② strengthen: 반대
❌ ③ maintain: 무관
det.tip: cancel each other out = 서로 상쇄하다

questions.passage: Rarely do people want to put up with a lot of noise because it can be unpleasant and __________ (distract).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: distract(동사) → distracting(형용사): unpleasant과 and 병렬
det.analysis:
distract → distracting(형용사)
unpleasant and ______ → 병렬 구조

questions.passage: Therefore, this noise-cancellation technology is effective for __________ (predict) sounds like those of car engines and subways that occur regularly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: predict(동사) → predictable(형용사): sounds를 수식
det.analysis:
predict → predictable(형용사)
예측 가능한 소리 = predictable sounds

questions.passage: Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. The microphones pick up sounds from the outside, and the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 외부 소리를 분석하여 반대 음파를 생성하는 장치를 본문에서 1단어로 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: "the circuitry analyzes them to produce opposite sound waves" → circuitry
det.analysis: 답 = circuitry (회로)

questions.passage: As technology advances, many people expect it will solve various social issues caused by noise pollution. A common source of these problems is noisy neighbors, as the noise they make can lead to conflict among residents.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 다양한 사회적 문제를 야기하는 원인을 본문에서 2단어로 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: "social issues caused by noise pollution" → 소음 공해
det.analysis: 원인 = noise pollution
det.tip: caused by = ~에 의해 야기된 → 원인 단서

questions.passage: Destructive interference is used in the noise-cancelling feature of headphones. Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry. However, it is not easy to entirely eliminate external noise with this technology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: "Inside the headphones are microphones and noise-cancelling circuitry" → 일치
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 마이크와 회로: 원문 일치
❌ ① destructive(상쇄)가 사용됨
❌ ② 사람 대화에 덜 효과적
❌ ④ "not easy to entirely eliminate"

ch: 이 기술은 사람 대화에 가장 효과적이다.
헤드폰 내부에 마이크와 소음 제거 회로가 있다.
외부 소음을 완전히 제거하는 것은 쉽다.

questions.passage: Noise-cancelling technology is not only used in music devices. Microphones are installed in ticket offices to detect external noise. They use noise-cancelling headsets in drive-throughs. The same technology is also used for cars. However, it is relatively less effective for inconsistent sounds such as those of people talking close to you.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: "less effective for inconsistent sounds" → 불규칙 소음에 덜 효과적. "가장 효과적"은 반대.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ 불규칙 소음에 가장 효과적: "less effective" → 반대
✅ ①②③ 원문 일치

ch: 자동차 오디오 시스템이 엔진 소음을 상쇄한다.
이 기술은 불규칙적인 소음에 가장 효과적이다.

questions.passage: Which is the better environment for studying: a noisy place or a quiet place? Fortunately, scientists have invented noise-cancelling technology. What is the scientific principle behind this achievement?
questions.stem: 이 글 전체의 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 음파 원리 → 상쇄 간섭 → 활용 분야 = 원리와 활용 설명
det.analysis:
✅ ② 원리와 활용 설명
❌ ① 경고 아님
❌ ③ 제품 없음
❌ ④ 실험 안내 아님
det.tip: 글의 구조: 원리 → 작동 → 적용 = 설명문

ch: 노이즈 캔슬링의 원리와 활용을 설명하기 위해

questions.passage: Sound is produced through vibrations that occur from a sound source, when the strings of a guitar are played, for instance.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"Sound is produced through vibrations from a sound source."

det.korean: 본문과 정확히 일치 → True
det.analysis: ✅ True: 본문 일치

questions.passage: However, it is not easy to entirely eliminate external noise with this technology. It is relatively less effective for inconsistent sounds such as those of people talking close to you.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"Noise-cancelling technology can completely eliminate all types of noise."

det.korean: "not easy to entirely eliminate" → 완전히 제거 불가 → False
det.analysis: ❌ False: "not easy to entirely eliminate" + "less effective for inconsistent sounds"

questions.passage: The same technology is also used for cars, whose audio systems generate waves to cancel out unpleasant sounds such as engine, wind, and road noise. Thanks to noise-cancelling devices, it is possible for drivers to focus on driving without being disturbed.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"Car audio systems amplify engine sounds for a better driving experience."

det.korean: "cancel out unpleasant sounds such as engine" → 엔진 소음을 상쇄, 증폭이 아님. → False
det.analysis: ❌ False: cancel out(상쇄) ≠ amplify(증폭)

questions.passage: The collected waves then travel through the ear canal and reach the eardrum located in the middle ear. When the eardrum vibrates, these vibrations are transmitted to three small bones in the middle ear.
questions.stem:
다음 진술이 본문의 내용과 일치하면 True, 일치하지 않으면 False를 고르시오.

"The eardrum is located in the middle ear."

det.korean: "the eardrum located in the middle ear" → True
det.analysis: ✅ True: 본문과 정확히 일치
